xs.$description: Hairline lift for tiny controls such as switch thumbs and slider handles.

sm.$description: Small floating controls such as carousel arrows, tab scroll buttons, and media chips.

md.$description: Resting surfaces sitting on the secondary background: cards and tooltips.

lg.$description: Transient overlays anchored to a surface: popovers and toasts.

xl.$description: Large floating navigation such as the sidebar.

2xl.$description: Modal dialogs, drawers, and bottom sheets above the page.

3xl.$description: Reserved for full-screen or hero overlays above a stacked modal.
